Requirement_Text: Product must exceed HackRF One in instantaneous bandwidth by at least 25x
Product must exceed HackRF One in dynamic range by at least 30 dB
RF input impedance must be 50 Ohm with SMA connector
Noise figure of input path must not exceed 3.5 dB
RF path must have switched preselectors and overload protection up to +20 dBm
RF output driver: linear amplifier up to 1.5 W for max diffraction efficiency
Laser diode wavelength λ = 650 nm (or 532 nm)
Laser optical power stability not worse than 0.5%
Automatic power regulation circuit (ARM) must be present
Bragg cell: TeO₂ crystal
Bragg cell end faces: dielectric coating R < 0.2%
Optical scheme: telescope-colllimator and Fourier lens with spherical aberration compensation
CMOS array: minimum 2048 pixels
CMOS pixel dynamic range: not less than 72 dB
CMOS line readout frequency: not less than 50 kHz
Operating temperature range: +15°C to +30°C
Storage temperature range: -40°C to +50°C
Relative humidity: not more than 80% at +25°C
Active thermal stabilization: ±0.1°C accuracy using Peltier elements
Vibration resistance: 10-55 Hz
Optical base: D16T alloy (Al 2024-T3)
Optical axis drift: not more than 0.5 μm at max temp
Emission level: not exceed CISPR 22-2012 Class B
Immunity: IEC 61000-4-3
Shielding: Al alloy case
MTBF: not less than 10
Electrical safety: GOST IEC 60950-1-2014/IEC 62368-1
Preservation: VZ-10 variant
Conservation: silica gel per GOST 3956-76
Case: hard polypropylene
Foam insert: chemically neutral PU
Package marking: GOST 14192-96/ISO 780:2015
Low-level software: cross-platform C/C++ driver
Upper-level software: GNU Radio open module Source block
USB 3.0 continuous capture without drops
Signal-to-noise ratio of the receive path must be at least 60 dB
Notes: SNR ≥60 dB in 2.7 kHz at -60 dBm; ≥10 dB at MDS

Requirement_Text: Receiver noise floor must not exceed -120 dBm in 2.7 kHz bandwidth
Notes: MDS ≤ -110 dBm; consistent with NF REQ-04
